aka.zh: 墨西哥城—华雷斯城公路

aka.en: Querétaro–Ciudad Juárez corridor (the federal trunk corridor it belongs to)
aka.zh: 克雷塔罗—华雷斯城走廊（其所属的联邦干线走廊）

tagline.en: The silver road to the north, rebuilt for lorries: from the Hidalgo hills to the El Paso bridges
tagline.zh: 通往北方的白银之路，为货车而重建：从伊达尔戈山地到埃尔帕索的边境桥

start.en: Portezuelo, Hidalgo, at the junction with Federal Highway 85 — the southern end of the drawn line. Sources disagree on the true southern end: English Wikipedia puts it at Panales, Hidalgo; Spanish Wikipedia carries the number on to Santiago Yancuitlalpan in Huixquilucan, west of Mexico City.
start.zh: 伊达尔戈州波特苏埃洛，与 85 号联邦公路交会处——图上线路的南端。关于真正的南端各方说法不一：英文维基百科定在伊达尔戈州帕纳莱斯；西班牙文维基百科则把这一编号一直延到墨西哥城以西乌伊斯基卢坎的圣地亚哥扬奎特拉尔潘。

end.en: Ciudad Juárez, Chihuahua, at the border with El Paso, Texas
end.zh: 奇瓦瓦州华雷斯城，与美国得克萨斯州埃尔帕索接壤的边境

en: Federal Highway 45 runs from the hills of Hidalgo north-west across the Bajío and the high plateau to the Rio Grande. North of Querétaro it passes through Celaya, Salamanca, Irapuato, Silao and León in Guanajuato, Lagos de Moreno in Jalisco, Aguascalientes, Zacatecas and Fresnillo, Sombrerete, Durango, Hidalgo del Parral, Jiménez, Camargo, Delicias and Chihuahua, and then crosses the Chihuahuan Desert by El Sueco, Villa Ahumada and Samalayuca to Ciudad Juárez.

It is two roads under one number. The free road, the libre, is the federal Highway 45. Beside it, in discontinuous pieces, runs the tolled 45D, the autopista México–Ciudad Juárez, which Spanish Wikipedia puts at 513 km. Through León, Celaya and Aguascalientes the libre itself runs through a long sequence of interchanges; across Chihuahua the four-lane toll sections were built as roads parallel to the old one.

Its length is not settled. English Wikipedia, adding up the federal transport ministry's 2024 Datos Viales state by state, gives 1,491.73 km; Spanish Wikipedia gives 1,920 km, but counts the road on through the State of Mexico to the western edge of the capital. The ministry counts the road within the Querétaro–Ciudad Juárez corridor, one of fifteen federal trunk corridors.
zh: 45 号联邦公路自伊达尔戈州的山地向西北而行，穿过巴希奥地区与高原，直抵格兰德河。克雷塔罗以北，它依次经过瓜纳华托州的塞拉亚、萨拉曼卡、伊拉普阿托、锡劳和莱昂，哈利斯科州的拉戈斯德莫雷诺，阿瓜斯卡连特斯，萨卡特卡斯与弗雷斯尼约，松布雷雷特，杜兰戈，伊达尔戈德尔帕拉尔，希门尼斯、卡马戈、德利西亚斯和奇瓦瓦，随后经埃尔苏埃科、比亚阿乌马达和萨马拉尤卡横越奇瓦瓦沙漠，抵达华雷斯城。
同一个编号下其实是两条路。不收费的“libre”是联邦 45 号公路本身；在它旁边分段并行的是收费的 45D，即墨西哥城—华雷斯城高速公路，西班牙文维基百科记其长 513 公里。在莱昂、塞拉亚和阿瓜斯卡连特斯，libre 本身一路穿过一连串立交；在奇瓦瓦全境，四车道收费段是作为旧路的并行道路修建的。
它的长度并无定论。英文维基百科按联邦交通部 2024 年各州《道路数据》（Datos Viales）累加，得 1,491.73 公里；西班牙文维基百科给出 1,920 公里，但把这条路一直算到墨西哥州、首都西缘。交通部把这条路归入“克雷塔罗—华雷斯城”走廊，这是全国十五条联邦干线走廊之一。

en: The line is far older than the road. In April 1598 an expedition led by Juan de Oñate reached the Río del Norte just south of present-day El Paso and Ciudad Juárez, and the route it mapped became the Camino Real de Tierra Adentro, the royal road from Mexico City to Santa Fe, used until 1882. UNESCO's evaluation describes it as having first ended at the silver mines of Zacatecas before being extended north. On 1 August 2010 sixty sites along 1,400 km of its Mexican section, between Mexico City and Valle de Allende in southern Chihuahua, were inscribed together as a World Heritage Site, among them the historic centres of Querétaro, Zacatecas and Sombrerete, all on Highway 45 today.

The railway came first in modern form: the Mexican Central's line joined the capital to the border at Ciudad Juárez in 1884. The federal road network grew section by section through the 1930s and 1940s, and its longest road, from Ciudad Juárez to the Guatemalan border, was opened under President Miguel Alemán. The ministry's own history describes the conclusion of the México–Ciudad Juárez road, inaugurated on 21 May 1950, as the most important road project of its day, because it formed the northern part of Mexico's Pan-American Highway: 3,446 km from Ciudad Juárez to Ocotal (Ciudad Cuauhtémoc) on the Guatemalan border. Alemán's 1950 report to Congress gave it as 3,440 km.

Days before the inauguration the new road carried the first Carrera Panamericana. Forty thousand spectators watched the start in Ciudad Juárez on 5 May 1950, and the race ran south through the capital to Ocotal, finishing on 10 May; Hershel McGriff and Ray Elliot won in an Oldsmobile 88. The race was held every year until 1954, when it was ended by presidential decree; the ministry's history records 27 drivers killed in its five editions.
zh: 这条线路比公路古老得多。1598 年 4 月，胡安·德·奥尼亚特率领的远征队抵达今埃尔帕索与华雷斯城以南的北河（格兰德河），他们勘定的路线成为“内陆皇家大道”（Camino Real de Tierra Adentro），即自墨西哥城通往圣菲的皇家大道，一直使用到 1882 年。联合国教科文组织的评估称，这条路最初止于萨卡特卡斯的银矿，后来才向北延伸。2010 年 8 月 1 日，其墨西哥段自墨西哥城至奇瓦瓦州南部巴耶德阿连德之间 1,400 公里沿线的六十处遗产点被整体列入《世界遗产名录》，其中包括克雷塔罗、萨卡特卡斯和松布雷雷特的历史中心——今天都在 45 号公路沿线。

近代先到的是铁路：墨西哥中央铁路于 1884 年把首都与华雷斯城边境连接起来。1930 至 1940 年代，联邦公路网逐段扩展；其中最长的一条，即自华雷斯城至危地马拉边境的公路，在米格尔·阿莱曼总统任内通车。交通部自己的史料称，1950 年 5 月 21 日落成的墨西哥城—华雷斯城公路是当时最重要的公路工程，因为它构成了墨西哥境内泛美公路的北段：自华雷斯城至危地马拉边境的奥科塔尔（今库奥特莫克城），全长 3,446 公里。阿莱曼 1950 年的国情咨文则称 3,440 公里。
落成前几天，这条新路上举行了第一届泛美公路汽车赛。1950 年 5 月 5 日，四万名观众在华雷斯城观看发车，赛事一路南下，经首都直抵奥科塔尔，于 5 月 10 日结束；赫谢尔·麦格里夫与雷·埃利奥特驾驶奥兹莫比尔 88 夺冠。此后比赛年年举办，直至 1954 年被总统令取消；交通部的史料记载，五届比赛共有 27 名车手丧生。

en: No cost for the road as a whole has been published; it was built in sections over decades and rebuilt since. The modern widening is accounted for project by project. The 47.6 km from Portezuelo to Palmillas at the southern end, where the road crosses from Hidalgo into Querétaro, was widened to four lanes with new grade-separated junctions and bridges for 1,364.4 million pesos, and handed over by the ministry on 9 August 2018.

In Chihuahua the four-lane road was largely paid for by tolls. A federal concession of 27 October 1988 let the state government build and run four lanes between Delicias and Camargo; a second, of 29 August 1989, covered Jiménez–Camargo and the sections from kilometre 83 north of Chihuahua through El Sueco and Villa Ahumada to Samalayuca, 306 km in all. That concession, first granted for seventeen years, has been extended to 2049 and since 2016 has been held by Fibra Estatal Chihuahua. The result is a road of mixed jurisdiction: as of June 2025 the state maintained Chihuahua–Sacramento and El Sueco–Villa Ahumada, and the federal ministry the rest of the road to Ciudad Juárez.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价；这条路数十年间分段修建，此后又不断改建。现代的拓宽工程逐项核算。南端自波特苏埃洛至帕尔米利亚斯的 47.6 公里——公路在此由伊达尔戈进入克雷塔罗——拓宽为四车道，新建分离式立交与桥梁，耗资 13.644 亿比索，交通部于 2018 年 8 月 9 日交付使用。

在奇瓦瓦州，四车道道路主要靠通行费筹资。1988 年 10 月 27 日的一项联邦特许，允许州政府修建并经营德利西亚斯至卡马戈之间的四车道；1989 年 8 月 29 日的第二项特许涵盖希门尼斯—卡马戈段，以及自奇瓦瓦以北 83 公里处经埃尔苏埃科、比亚阿乌马达至萨马拉尤卡的各段，共 306 公里。这项特许最初为期十七年，已延长至 2049 年，2016 年起由 Fibra Estatal Chihuahua 持有。结果是一条管辖权交错的道路：截至 2025 年 6 月，奇瓦瓦—萨克拉门托段与埃尔苏埃科—比亚阿乌马达段由州政府养护，其余通往华雷斯城的路段由联邦交通部负责。

en: Local press describes the Chihuahua–Juárez road as an industrial and commercial route whose heavy lorry traffic wears the surface quickly. In June 2026 the ministry it began resurfacing 33 km in four stretches between Villa Ahumada and Ciudad Juárez, milling off the old surface and laying 5 cm of new asphalt with a paving train, as part of a national maintenance programme.
zh: 当地媒体称，奇瓦瓦—华雷斯公路以工业与商贸运输为主，重型货车多，路面损耗快。2026 年 6 月，交通部开始用摊铺列车对比亚阿乌马达至华雷斯城之间四段共 33 公里进行翻修：铣刨旧路面，铺设 5 厘米新沥青，属全国道路养护计划的一部分。

en: Where the toll and free roads run in parallel, the toll road is the faster. Chihuahua's state road agency lists toll plazas on Route 45 at Sacramento (state toll, kilometre 31 north of Chihuahua), Villa Ahumada (federal concession, kilometre 216), and Saucillo, Camargo and Jiménez to the south. Further south the toll and free roads share a carriageway around Irapuato, and there is a National Guard checkpoint on the free road near Cosío, in northern Aguascalientes.
zh: 收费路与免费路并行之处，收费路更快。奇瓦瓦州道路部门列出的 45 号线收费站有：萨克拉门托（州收费站，奇瓦瓦以北 31 公里处）、比亚阿乌马达（联邦特许，216 公里处），以及南面的绍西略、卡马戈和希门尼斯。再往南，收费路与免费路在伊拉普阿托一带共用路幅；在阿瓜斯卡连特斯州北部科西奥附近的免费路上设有国民警卫队检查站。

value.en: Sources disagree. 1,491.73 km, summed from the 2024 Datos Viales of the eight states it crosses, in English Wikipedia; 1,920 km in Spanish Wikipedia, which counts the road on to Huixquilucan west of Mexico City.
value.zh: 各方不一。英文维基百科按所经八州 2024 年《道路数据》累加为 1,491.73 公里；西班牙文维基百科作 1,920 公里，把道路一直算到墨西哥城以西的乌伊斯基卢坎。

figures.source: SCT Dirección General de Servicios Técnicos, Datos Viales 2024 (eight states), as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 45; Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 45

value.en: 513 km in discontinuous sections, the longest 234 km in Chihuahua
value.zh: 分段不连续，共 513 公里，其中最长的奇瓦瓦段 234 公里

value.en: México–Ciudad Juárez inaugurated 21 May 1950, as part of a 3,446 km Ciudad Juárez–Ocotal route (3,440 km in the president's 1950 report)
value.zh: 墨西哥城—华雷斯城段于 1950 年 5 月 21 日落成，属华雷斯城至奥科塔尔全长 3,446 公里的线路（1950 年总统国情咨文作 3,440 公里）

figures.source: SCT, El Mirador: “Caminos y puentes federales de ingresos” and “La Carretera Panamericana y su célebre carrera”, citing Miguel Alemán's fourth report to Congress, 1 September 1950

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. The road was built in sections from the 1930s to 1950 and has been widened piecemeal since; the sources read give no cost for the original construction. A sourced modern section cost is given below.
why.zh: 无全线公开数据。该路自 1930 年代至 1950 年分段修建，此后又逐段拓宽；所查资料均未给出原始建设造价。下列为有来源的现代分段造价。

label.zh: 波特苏埃洛—帕尔米利亚斯段拓宽

value.en: 1,364.4 million pesos for 47.6 km widened to four lanes (works 2017, handed over 9 August 2018)
value.zh: 47.6 公里拓宽为四车道，投资 13.644 亿比索（2017 年施工，2018 年 8 月 9 日交付）

figures.source: SCT Dirección General de Carreteras, Memoria documental 2013–2018; SCT announcement of 9 August 2018 as reported by News Hidalgo

value.en: The free road is federal. The parallel four-lane toll sections in Chihuahua were built under federal concessions to the Chihuahua state government (27 October 1988, Delicias–Camargo; 29 August 1989, 306 km between Jiménez and Samalayuca) and are repaid from tolls; the 1989 concession now runs to 29 August 2049 and has been held by Fibra Estatal Chihuahua since 2016.
value.zh: 免费路由联邦出资。奇瓦瓦州的并行四车道收费段依据联邦对奇瓦瓦州政府的特许修建（1988 年 10 月 27 日，德利西亚斯—卡马戈；1989 年 8 月 29 日，希门尼斯至萨马拉尤卡之间 306 公里），以通行费偿还；1989 年的特许现延至 2049 年 8 月 29 日，2016 年起由 Fibra Estatal Chihuahua 持有。

figures.source: SICT, Títulos de concesión (Dirección General de Desarrollo Carretero); Proyectos México, project 0132

value.en: Reported at 861.35 million pesos for periodic and routine maintenance of 743.26 km of Route 45 in Chihuahua, quoting the deputy works director of the ministry's Chihuahua office; a newspaper column, not checked against the ministry's programme figures.
value.zh: 据报道，奇瓦瓦州境内 45 号线 743.26 公里的定期与日常养护投资 8.6135 亿比索，引自交通部奇瓦瓦中心工程副主任；出自报纸专栏，未与该部计划数据核对。

timeline.en: Juan de Oñate's expedition reaches the Río del Norte at the site of Ciudad Juárez, fixing the line of the Camino Real de Tierra Adentro.
timeline.zh: 胡安·德·奥尼亚特的远征队抵达今华雷斯城一带的北河，内陆皇家大道的走向由此确定。

timeline.en: The Mexican Central Railway joins Mexico City to Ciudad Juárez.
timeline.zh: 墨西哥中央铁路连通墨西哥城与华雷斯城。

timeline.en: The first Carrera Panamericana starts from Ciudad Juárez on 5 May; the México–Ciudad Juárez road is officially inaugurated on 21 May as part of the Pan-American Highway.
timeline.zh: 5 月 5 日，第一届泛美公路汽车赛自华雷斯城发车；5 月 21 日，墨西哥城—华雷斯城公路作为泛美公路的一部分正式落成。

timeline.en: The Carrera Panamericana is ended by presidential decree after its fifth edition.
timeline.zh: 泛美公路汽车赛举办五届后被总统令取消。

timeline.en: A federal concession of 27 October lets Chihuahua build four lanes between Delicias and Camargo.
timeline.zh: 10 月 27 日，联邦特许奇瓦瓦州修建德利西亚斯至卡马戈的四车道。

timeline.en: A second concession, of 29 August, covers 306 km of parallel toll road from Jiménez to Samalayuca.
timeline.zh: 8 月 29 日，第二项特许涵盖自希门尼斯至萨马拉尤卡 306 公里的并行收费路。

timeline.en: Sixty sites along the Camino Real de Tierra Adentro are inscribed as a World Heritage Site on 1 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 1 日，内陆皇家大道沿线六十处遗产点被列入《世界遗产名录》。

timeline.en: The four-lane Portezuelo–Palmillas section is handed over on 9 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 9 日，波特苏埃洛—帕尔米利亚斯四车道段交付使用。

timeline.en: Resurfacing of 33 km between Villa Ahumada and Ciudad Juárez begins in June.
timeline.zh: 6 月，比亚阿乌马达至华雷斯城之间 33 公里路面翻修开工。
